source_text: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.

source_text: An Ezomyte endures.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: That most legendary caravan bandit had

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: one rule: never let them see you flinch.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Knowing she could outlast any opponent,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Some would question if the risk was worth it.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The rest were already dead.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The warrior who fears will fall.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: To catch an animal, think like an animal.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The blasted oak stands forever.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The desert is ever flowing.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: - Taruk of the Wildmen

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: but life always springs back anew.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: As the serpent wills.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Shedding away her regal past,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: she forged a new destiny.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Seizing her one true wish,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: she found peace at last.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Feed a beast and it will not hunt.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Protect it and it will not fight.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Ferocity must be learned, not taught.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: tipped with a poisoned hatred

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: only oppression can ferment.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: shadowed the Auspex for the rest of his days.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
source_text: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.

category: 风味文本与风味名称候选
